def _raw(x, coefficients):

            + coefficients[:, 6] * x * np.roll(x, -1, axis=-1))


def _calibrate(study):

        def jac(x):

        result.append(least_squares(lambda x: _raw(x, t) - y, x, jac=jac,
                                   gtol=1e-13, xtol=1e-13, ftol=1e-13).x)
    return np.asarray(result).ravel()
